your_book:
Monday was a split session for Jaleel's book, with the overall portfolio sitting at a –1.22% unrealized loss. The headline mover was NVDA (+1.68%), the largest position at 12% of the book, continuing to carry its weight with a +12.8% open gain — Jensen Huang's public comments on AI safety kept the name in focus without denting sentiment. AZO (+1.43%) and DHR (+1.27%) also contributed positively, while NBIX popped +1.47% despite sitting –13.8% in the hole — a welcome day but not a trend yet. On the negative side, RKLB slid another –2.38%, deepening a –7.9% loss on a position the model already flags AVOID; there was a specific headline asking why the stock was falling today, which is never a good sign. ADBE dropped –1.89% and SPGI –1.83%, both adding to existing open losses.

The drift problem is real across several names. BSX (8.6% weight, STRONG BUY, QARP 80.1) is down –10.0% with a risk flag noting guidance was slashed and management is guiding flat through Q3 — price and thesis are clearly not aligned yet. ZTS (9.5%, STRONG BUY) is –9.3% in the red. LULU carries the most painful divergence: rated BUY with a QARP of 71.9 yet sitting –21.3% with five straight quarters of negative Americas comps and a guidance cut — conviction needs to be stress-tested, not assumed. EXE dropped –1.76% today and is –8.8% overall on a STRONG BUY rating; energy names are sensitive to macro and commodity shifts that can move faster than thesis updates.

Watch the pharma cluster into October 22, when drug-pricing policy risk is flagged for GILD, NVS, NBIX, and VRTX — MFN pricing deals and import tariffs create an overhang across ~5.7% of the book. ABT reports October 13 with an EPS guide already trimmed; it edged down –0.31% today and remains the book's second-largest position at 9.8%.

attention.headline: AVOID-rated name falling again with no thesis support
attention.note: RKLB dropped –2.38% today, is –7.9% in the hole, carries a QARP of 37.7, and is explicitly rated AVOID — there is no data-supported case for continuing to hold this position in a capital-preservation book.

attention.headline: –21.3% loss with deteriorating fundamentals demands a conviction reset
attention.note: Five straight quarters of negative Americas comps, a guidance cut, tariff margin pressure, and China stalling make the BUY rating look increasingly aspirational — the next catalyst isn't until December 9, a long time to remain this far offside.

attention.headline: Guidance slashed, flat growth guided through Q3, –10% open loss
attention.note: Despite an 80.1 QARP and STRONG BUY verdict, price is disconnecting from thesis — management's own guidance cut to 7–8.5% growth and flat Q3 outlook means the earnings print on October 28 is a critical re-rating moment.

attention.headline: –1.89% today; narrative risk overriding solid numbers
attention.note: The risk flag notes that beat-and-raise wasn't enough to stop the selloff — AI-moat fears, a CFO exit, and ARR de-emphasis mean sentiment can keep dragging price lower regardless of fundamentals, and the next look isn't until December 9.
